desc: Distinguish yourself with a Citori 825 Noir Trap over and under shotgun. Featuring a dark-stained AAAA maple stock with a raised Monte Carlo comb and semi-beavertail forearm with finger grooves; Gloss blued finish; Fire Lite 2 Mechanical Trigger; Inflex II recoil pad; Midas grade Invector-DS chokes; High-post trap rib and HiViz Pro Comp sight. Includes 5 extended Midas Grade choke tubes.
